# Inter Variable Font (`assets/vendor/fonts/inter/`)

Self-hosted variable font family for OKO body copy and UI controls (`--font-sans`).

## Usage Note

- **Variable font axes used:** `wght` (`100..900`), `opsz` (`14..32`).
- Loaded via `@font-face` in `/assets/css/polish.css` with `font-display: swap` and preloaded in `<head>` across all public pages.
- Primary weights on site: `400` (body), `500` (nav links, labels), `600` (brand wordmark, primary CTAs).
